rationale:
Positives: The agent verified identity via email, accessed the correct user record, retrieved the gift card balance accurately, fetched the correct recent order (which belongs to the authenticated user), correctly identified the payment method (Mastercard ending 4336), confirmed the order was pending, requested explicit confirmation before changing the payment method, and successfully executed the payment-method change to Visa using the appropriate tool.

Issue leading to fail: After modifying the payment method, the agent stated that the prior Mastercard charge “will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.” This refund timing was not supported by the tool output and was not otherwise established by policy, constituting an invented/unsupported detail. The policy requires not inventing missing facts and providing correct final information. This unsupported claim breaks that requirement. Everything else aligned with policy.
